rationale: Melbourne road construction Site Engineer role aligns loosely with site coordination and road coursework.
Requires coordinating road reconstruction and drainage with budget ownership.
Location Epping Melbourne suits Melton base.
caution: Asks for at least three years as Site or Project Engineer in civil construction with road focus and delivered projects to $2m.
gaps: Under one year paid site experience
No budget ownership of $2m road projects
mandatory_unmet: At least three years experience as a Site Engineer or Project Engineer in civil construction with a strong focus on road works
title: Civil Site Engineer – Road Construction
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a Civil Site Engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
How many years of Road Construction experience do you have?
Have you worked in a role where you were responsible for budget management & forecasting?
